description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayProcessManager component of the OpenClaw project, specifically testing behaviors related to gateway health checks, attachment, and process management within the OpenClaw macOS application.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManagerTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for GatewayProcessManager, containing multiple test cases for gateway health and attachment behaviors.

methods.name: `clears last failure when health succeeds`
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying that the GatewayProcessManager clears the last failure reason when gateway health check succeeds.

methods.name: `attaches to existing gateway without spawning launchd`
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying that the GatewayProcessManager can attach to an existing gateway process without launching a new one, based on simulated health data and process info.
